mechanics_repair_budget.reason: The first preflight restored every state but accessed parsed_problem on the outer OffScreenRenderEnv wrapper. Attempt 2 accesses the inner LIBERO task and reruns all 128 rows.

task_selection_rule: One prospectively fixed executable raw-demo task per LIBERO suite, spanning spatial pick-place, object pick-place, articulated fixture, and long-horizon multi-goal interaction families.

tasks.instruction: pick up the black bowl between the plate and the ramekin and place it on the plate
pick up the alphabet soup and place it in the basket
open the middle drawer of the cabinet
turn on the stove and put the moka pot on it

deployment_equivalent_action_unit.reconstruction: Restore and render the exact cache-origin physics state; reset the policy queue; call the official select_action path once to generate the chunk and pop through the registered offset. SmolVLA has no cross-chunk recurrent state or temporal ensembling in this lock.
deployment_equivalent_action_unit.normalization: official frozen policy preprocessor and postprocessor
deployment_equivalent_action_unit.execution_clipping: componentwise [-1, 1], matching the action bounds enforced by the simulator control path; raw and executed values are both retained
deployment_equivalent_action_unit.gripper_semantics: official relative-control gripper conversion is preserved

paired_splice.nominal_first_action: raw HDF5 expert action at the registered frame
paired_splice.candidate_first_action: checkpoint deployment-equivalent action unit at the same registered frame
paired_splice.continuation: identical raw HDF5 expert actions from frame+1 through frame+H in both branches
paired_splice.horizon_selection: shortest horizon passing nominal-twin stability and pooled small/medium perturbation monotonicity
paired_splice.sham: independent exact restore followed by the same nominal action and continuation

task_error.source: native LIBERO BDDL goal predicates and their object-state operands; no RGB distance
task_error.target: goal-operand pose/joint configuration after the final recorded expert action for the same raw demonstration, with native success audited
task_error.raw_error: mean of available scaled relative-position, relative-orientation, joint, and native-predicate violation components
task_error.task_normalization: divide by max(0.05, mechanics Q90 nominal error - mechanics Q10 nominal error), using mechanics rows only
task_error.primary_row_score: normalized candidate task error at H minus normalized nominal task error at H
invalid_conditions: premature terminal before the registered continuation completes
task_error.aggregation: mean within task followed by equal-task macro-average; lower is better; signed row scores are retained

mechanics_calibration.direction: deterministic SHA-256-derived six-arm direction with gripper unchanged; medium uses the same direction as small
mechanics_calibration.perturbation_role: assay validation only, never a checkpoint identity or scientific score

prohibited_uses: checkpoint training or weight updates from ICAE
full candidate checkpoint trajectory inside ICAE
held-out outcome access before pre-outcome freeze
